senses.gloss: m.(b. h. בֹּסֶר, בֵּסֶר; בסר II)half-ripe fruit, esp. grapes.
units: Shebi. IV, 8 הב׳ משהביא וכ׳ the boser from the time it contains liquid.
Gitt. III, 8 (31ᵃ) בשעת כניסת המים בב׳ when the liquid is beginning to gather in the boser; (oth. opin. when it can be put in water for making vinegar; v. Rashi a. l.).
<cite ref="Pesachim 53a:1">Pes. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>הוא ב׳ וכ׳</he> boser indicates the same stage of ripening as gerua, v. <cite ref="C01379"><he>גָּרַע</he></cite> Hif.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:3:4">Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Sukkah 36a:5">Succ. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>אתרוג הב׳</he> a half-ripe Ethrog.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 6:2:5">Y. B. Kam. VI, 5ᵇ</cite> bot.; a. fr.
